title: justicia santapaui
intro: Justicia santapaui, commonly known as "Tulsi" or "Holy Basil," is an herbaceous perennial plant native to the tropical and subtropical regions of Asia. It is revered for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce stress, improve respiratory health, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Justicia santapaui include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and adaptogenic properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, such as eugenol and rosmarinic acid, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
